ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) localized pixel distributions concentrated in linear abrasions and tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark field across 90%+ of total fluke area; high-intensity white clusters (rosettes) located at the far lateral terminal tips (left and right); sparse, disorganized linear white filaments (0.5-2.0% surface area) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is roughly 10% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; approximately 12-15 distinct peaks per lobe along the trailing boundary, creating a jagged saw-tooth profile isolated against the high-intensity background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges transitioning to tapered, pointed distal tips with a slight upward sweep relative to the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of roughly circular white pixel groups located at the extreme posterior-lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity linear pixel streaks (rake marks) present on both lobes; more concentrated on the lower-mid region of the left lobe and upper-lateral region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across ventral surface; prominent white scarring at terminal tips; distinct irregular notch on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe near the central median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Overall pigmentation pattern conforms to Type 1 (predominantly black) fluke categorization.
